children: H.B. Fuller priced an $850 million offering of 7.625% senior unsecured notes due 2034 at 100% to fund the AMS acquisition and refinancing.
Priced $850 million of 7.625% senior unsecured notes due 2034 in a Rule 144A/Reg S private offering.
Notes issued at 100% carry semi-annual interest and are expected to close on or about October 21, 2026.
Net proceeds, plus cash and borrowings, to fund acquisition of Advanced Medical Solutions, repay credit facility debt, and redeem 4.000% notes due 2027.
If acquisition not consummated by June 25, 2027 (Outside Date), H.B. Fuller must redeem $450 million of the notes at 100% plus accrued interest.
